purpose: Add a fast shared_handoff channel for Hermes and Codex to inspect each other's latest processing state without reading full logs or mutating each other's namespace.
write_rules: Hermes writes Hermes summary cards only in hermes_exec/.
Codex writes Codex summary cards only in codex_space/.
shared_handoff/90_QUICK_EXCHANGE_BOARD.json points to immutable summary cards and latest artifacts with sha256.
shared_handoff/90_QUICK_EXCHANGE_BOARD.json is append-by-new-version in real runs; do not overwrite historical boards.
shared_handoff/99_LATEST_POINTERS.json remains the full integrity pointer table; quick board is the human/agent-readable fast lane.
